verdicts.note: Courts routinely uphold reasonable regulation of constitutional rights, including licensing of drivers.
The Supreme Court held that reasonable motor vehicle licensing and fees do not infringe citizens' right to pass through a state; the law merely regulates dangerous machines and charges for road use.
